faq.q: Can I change the focus and break lengths?
faq.a: Yes. Preset buttons cover Classic 25/5, Deep Work 50/10, Short Bursts 15/3 and Exam Sprint 45/15, or choose Custom to set focus (1–180 min), short break, long break, and how many focus sessions happen before a long break (1–12). The default is a long break after every 4 focus sessions. An "Auto-start next phase" option chains phases without clicking.

faq.q: What does it track, and where is that stored?
faq.a: It counts completed focus sessions for today, this week, all-time, your day streak, total focus minutes and tasks done, plus a bar chart of the last 7 days. Dates use your local calendar (not UTC), so a session finished at 1 AM counts for the right day. All stats and settings live in your browser's local storage — nothing is sent to a server.

faq.q: How do tasks and the distraction log work?
faq.a: Add tasks and pin one as the current task; each completed focus session increments that task's tomato count. The Distraction button (or pressing D) logs an interruption with an optional note and timestamp so you can review what pulled you away. Completed focus sessions are also logged and can be exported as CSV or a text summary.

faq.q: Are there alerts and a distraction-free view?
faq.a: Yes. It plays a Web Audio chime at the end of each phase (with mute and a volume slider), and can show optional browser notifications if you grant permission. A full-screen Focus Mode shows just the big timer. Keyboard shortcuts: Space start/pause, R reset, S skip, D distraction, F focus mode, Esc exit.
